verdict.rationale: Jules documents a REST API with API keys, sessions, messaging and plan approval, so a downloadable machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows an OpenAPI or equivalent spec being published. Probes of all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths on jules.google returned 404, and the API documentation pages and community comments describe only usage, never a spec file.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
